manifest.name: MEM-µ
manifest.description: Gram-store memory micronaut — Pop-phase gramRead/gramWrite, confidence-keyed retrieval, interaction replay. Horizontal fold: single-turn memory access with confidence tracking.

mem.read.description: Pop-phase: read value from gram store by key and namespace. Returns stored value with confidence score and phase provenance.

mem.store.description: Pop/Xul-phase: write value to gram store with confidence score, phase tag, and source micronaut. xcfe_required for write ops.

mem.recall.description: Pop-phase: retrieve entries from gram store filtered by namespace, confidence threshold, and phase. Returns ranked list of matching entries.

mem.replay.description: Pop/Wo-phase: replay a sequence of gram-stored interactions by session ID or topic. Returns ordered interaction records.

mem.health.description: Pop-phase: reports gram store size, namespace coverage, confidence distribution, and replay buffer depth.
